title: Edge AI and IoT-Powered System for Early Tomato Disease Detection and Smart Control
summary: Mbeya University of Science and Technology pilot-tested a YOLOv9-based edge AI system that detects tomato diseases on its farm; no avoided crop loss, yield gain or pesticide saving is measured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST) in Tanzania reports that it pilot-tested an edge AI system for early tomato-disease detection on its demonstration farm. The system uses a YOLOv9 model and is designed to send alerts to farmers. The team reports the model's accuracy on image datasets. It has not measured avoided crop losses, higher yields or reduced pesticide use on any farm.
purpose: Detect tomato diseases early and deliver practical alerts to farmers.
system: Edge AI and IoT tomato-disease detection system
developer: Mbeya University of Science and Technology
